bullets.text: Ikea's Smart Home Revolution - **Ikea** aims to democratize smart home tech with new **Matter-compatible** devices.
Apple Fitness+ Under Review - **Apple** plans to reorganize **Fitness+** to combat high churn and low revenue.
Massive Apple Deals - Early **Black Friday** discounts include **M5 MacBook Pro** and **AirPods Pro 2**.
ESR's 3-in-1 Charger - The new **ESR** MagSafe stand offers 25W charging for **iPhone**, **Apple Watch**, and **AirPods**.
iOS 26.1 Enhancements - The latest **iOS** update boosts **AirPods Pro** with expanded Live Translation features.
YouTube TV's Customer Credit - Subscribers receive a $20 credit due to the **Disney** channel blackout.
Apple's Satellite Ambitions - **Apple** is developing satellite-powered features for the **iPhone**, enhancing connectivity.
iOS 26.2 Feature Changes - Upcoming **iOS** update may remove Wi-Fi syncing for **Apple Watch** in the EU.
